# FinanzBuddy 0.3.5

Feature release merging branch `budgetpools`: budget pools, transaction assignment UX, bank-import salary deduplication, shopping-list improvements, and assorted UI polish.

## Budget pools (new)

- New **Budget pools** tab under Expenses (before Shopping list)
- Create pools with planned amount per **salary period** or **calendar year**, icon, color, and optional notes
- **Scalable** pools: remaining budget carries into the next period; overspending reduces the next period’s planned amount
- Scalable pools require a **start period** when enabled
- List view shows **planned** (effective, incl. carry-over), **actual**, and **remaining** for the current period
- Click a pool name to open a **period history** popup (planned / actual / remaining per period)
- Assign budget pools on expense transactions via **Assign budget pools** (split modal); can coexist with category assignment (variable/fixed/shopping list)
- Budget pool icon/color applies to transactions when no category is set; category styles take precedence

## Transactions

- Expense category: dropdown (None / Variable / Fixed / Shopping list) plus separate search field per type
- **Split variable costs** button next to the category search when Variable is selected
- Separate modals for variable-cost splits and budget-pool splits
- Autocomplete suggestion popover closes reliably after selection
- Transaction **search** in the Dashboard and Transactions paginator boxes
- Error popup shows cause plus **Download error report** (JSON for developers)

## Bank import

- **Salary deduplication** when import periods overlap with materialized income forecasts
- Linking a bank income line to a forecast removes the duplicate prognostic ledger row and renames the import to the forecast title
- Improved auto-match for primary income (amount-based, even without counterparty IBAN on the import line)
- Materialization skips creating a forecast row when a matching bank import already exists in the period

## Shopping list

- **Total amount** and **Open amount** columns (replacing a single Amount column); groups show both sums, single items show the same value twice
- Group detail: clickable **product links** in descriptions (opens system browser)
- **Remove from group** uses a circle-off icon instead of text
- Booked (`applied`) items without a group can be added to a group
- Group split assignment includes parked and applied members where applicable

## Dashboard & tables

- **Lottie** loading animation instead of plain “Loading…” text
- Amount-column blue band starts at the first data row (not the header)
- Paginator: entry count on the right when search is active, on the left otherwise
- Shopping-list and buy-group UI alignment fixes; late group adds count toward prognosis

## Backend / database

- New tables: `budget_pools`, `ledger_budget_pool_splits`, `ledger_variable_cost_splits`
- Migrations: `budget_pools_v1`–`v3` (incl. `scalable`, `scalable_start_period_key`)
- Commands: budget pool CRUD, period history, expense split listing/application
